declared_purpose: Automate local WPS document creation, opening, listing, conversion and batch processing, with optional WPS 365 forms, collaborative documents, multidimensional tables, flowcharts and mind maps. The entry document explicitly makes local operations credential-free and cloud operations credential-dependent. Credential storage, unconditional initialization, GUI targeting and metadata selection are implementation choices.

data_operations.data_scope: app_id and app_secret; packaged values are empty. The instructions direct users to enter credentials into config.json. The manifest marks app_secret as secret but provides no storage implementation.
data_operations.condition: The user follows the optional cloud setup instructions. The script itself does not write credentials.

data_operations.operation: Read configuration and initialize controllers before dispatch
data_operations.data_scope: The complete configuration is deserialized; default_save_path, app_id and app_secret are extracted. Credentials are passed to cloud constructors regardless of the selected action.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Python process memory and controller attributes
data_operations.condition: Any invocation with an action argument. A nonempty app_id triggers requests.Session() in the form constructor, but requests is never imported in the supplied source; the CLI therefore stops before dispatch. With empty app_id, initialization proceeds without HTTP.

data_operations.operation: Detect operating system and probe WPS installation paths
data_operations.source: Local platform information, home-directory expansion and fixed filesystem locations
data_operations.data_scope: Operating-system name, expanded default save path and existence of candidate WPS installation paths
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: WPSController attributes in local process memory
data_operations.condition: Every invocation that reaches controller initialization, including cloud actions; probing precedes the configured-app_id failure.

data_operations.operation: Parse caller inputs and return command results
data_operations.source: Command-line arguments and selected controller results
data_operations.data_scope: Requested paths, content, names, identifiers, form data, field definitions, values, view configuration, filters and sorting parameters. Results can contain paths, metadata, echoed parameters and errors.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process memory; final JSON goes to stdout and its caller
data_operations.condition: Controller initialization completes. A normal returned result does not establish disclosure beyond the caller or persistent logging.

data_operations.operation: Create local files and attempt to launch documents
data_operations.source: Caller-selected document type, filename or existing filepath
data_operations.data_scope: Creation makes the save directory and touches the target file, creating an empty file if absent or updating an existing file's timestamps. Creation and opening pass the target path to a platform launch command.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local filesystem; WPS or the platform launch process receives the document path
data_operations.condition: Reachable create or open action. File creation can persist even if the subsequent launch fails. The source establishes a launch attempt, not successful application execution.

data_operations.operation: Deliver initial content through GUI keystrokes
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: The current active GUI window, which is not verified as the intended WPS document
data_operations.condition: Reachable create action with nonempty content, after the launch call and a three-second delay, when pyautogui imports successfully. No save operation follows typing.

data_operations.operation: Read Markdown and persist a converted derivative
data_operations.data_scope: The entire UTF-8 source is read and transformed into RTF on macOS or HTML elsewhere. The derived destination is opened in write mode, potentially truncating an existing file.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process memory and a persistent output file beside the input; macOS additionally passes the RTF path to WPS
data_operations.condition: The input exists, has extension .md and the requested output format is docx, doc or wps. Other conversion combinations merely return claimed output paths without implementing conversion. This path does not delete the source or clean up the derivative.

data_operations.operation: Enumerate document names, read metadata and infer document type
data_operations.data_scope: Immediate directory entries matching supported extensions; filename, joined path, size, modification time and a type label inferred from extension. File contents are not read by listing.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local list_documents result; standalone list returns it to the caller
data_operations.condition: Reachable list action or an internal batch_convert call; the directory exists.

data_operations.operation: Enumerate and process a directory for batch conversion
data_operations.source: list_documents results for the selected directory
data_operations.data_scope: All supported entries and their listing metadata are collected before target-format files are skipped. Conversion consumes paths; successful results retain filenames and counts.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local batch controller; supported Markdown conversions persist local derivatives; summary goes to the caller
data_operations.condition: Reachable batch_convert action and an existing directory. Content reads and output writes occur only for the implemented Markdown conversion branch.

data_operations.operation: Define OAuth credential transmission and token caching
data_operations.data_scope: A client_credentials request sends app_id as client_id and app_secret as client_secret. The returned access_token is cached in the controller; authentication exceptions are printed to stderr.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: HTTPS POST to https://open.wps.cn/api/auth/v1/token; token in local process memory
data_operations.condition: Defined behavior requires a working session and both credentials. It is blocked through the supplied CLI because nonempty app_id encounters the missing requests import. No token file persistence or expiry-based refresh is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Define an authenticated remote form-list request
data_operations.source: Access token, optional caller-supplied folder_id and API response
data_operations.data_scope: The GET sends a bearer token and optional folder_id. Successful response forms and total are returned by list_forms. The generic helper returns raw error bodies internally; list_forms instead returns a generic API error and synthetic fallback records.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: HTTPS GET to https://open.wps.cn/api/forms/v1/list; response in process memory and selected results to the caller
data_operations.condition: form_list invokes this path if initialization and authentication succeed; the packaged CLI currently blocks it at initialization. POST, PUT and DELETE are helper branches without packaged action callers, so they do not establish remote writes or deletions.

data_operations.operation: Construct mock cloud records and acknowledgements locally
data_operations.data_scope: Form data/submission/creation; document listing/creation/content/sharing; sheet data, updates, views, fields and queries; flowchart and mind-map listing/creation/export. Some identifiers, names, ranges, filters and sorting parameters are echoed. Example people and records are synthetic.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Method return values to the caller; constructed share/download URL strings are not visited
data_operations.condition: These method bodies require nonempty app_id but make no API calls or persistent cloud changes. The supplied CLI cannot reach them with that setting because its earlier form constructor fails. They do not demonstrate actual collection, submission, sharing or export of user cloud records.

potential_excess.data_scope: User-provisioned app_secret stored as a plaintext JSON value
potential_excess.condition: A user follows optional WPS 365 credential setup; the shipped file contains no populated credential.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Real cloud authentication requires credentials, but durable plaintext storage is a setup choice. The entry document recommends alternatives while stating environment-variable support is forthcoming.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Supply the application credentials to the authentication request when real cloud access is requested.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Add a credential-provider or environment-variable implementation so app_secret need not be persisted in the package configuration.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain local configuration and optional cloud authentication. Environment-variable support must be implemented rather than assumed to exist.

potential_excess.data_scope: app_id and app_secret read and passed to cloud constructors during local-only actions
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: config.json to main-process memory and cloud controller attributes
potential_excess.condition: Any local action when credentials are present. A nonempty app_id currently causes failure in the form constructor; this does not prevent the preceding credential read.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Local document operations explicitly require no credentials. Unconditional credential loading and cloud initialization are redundant actions for that execution path.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Read the local save-path configuration and initialize the controller needed for the selected local operation.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Dispatch by action first, separate credential storage from ordinary local configuration, and load credentials and cloud controllers only for the relevant authenticated operation.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep local actions functional without credentials and retain authentication for the real form-list path. Account for the existing missing requests import when implementing cloud initialization.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: An unverified active GUI window instead of a confirmed intended WPS document
potential_excess.condition: create receives content and pyautogui is available; another window can hold focus after the fixed delay.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Creating a document with content requires delivery to that document. Delivery to whichever window is active broadens the recipient; the entry document acknowledges this implementation risk.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Insert the requested content into the intended newly created document.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use a document-specific writing interface or verify the target WPS window and document before typing, stopping if verification fails.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve requested content insertion. This narrows the recipient of a required action rather than removing content needed for creation.

potential_excess.data_scope: File sizes, modification times and inferred document-type labels gathered during batch conversion
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local filesystem metadata and derived attributes to the internal list_documents result consumed by batch_convert
potential_excess.condition: batch_convert calls list_documents. These attributes stay inside the helper result and are not included in the batch summary.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Batch conversion requires eligible paths and names. Its implementation never consumes the size, modification-time or type-label fields.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Enumerate supported entries, skip the target format, convert selected paths and report names and counts.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use a lightweight path/name iterator for batching, omitting size and timestamp reads and type-label construction. This removes extra data from necessary enumeration, including redundant metadata reads.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve extension filtering, target-format skipping and batch results; retain richer metadata for standalone listing if desired.

unknowns: External WPS and GUI-library behavior is not supplied. Successful launch, the actual focused recipient, saving of typed content, autosave, synchronization, telemetry and downstream retention remain unresolved.

The authenticated network path is blocked in the supplied CLI by the missing requests import. Actual endpoint behavior, OAuth permissions, response schemas and service-side retention cannot be established from the request definitions.
Form response objects have no supplied schema or field-selection contract, so whether their returned fields exceed the requested listing cannot be determined.
Retention and eventual deletion of user-populated credentials, created files and conversion derivatives are unspecified. No packaged action invokes the generic HTTP DELETE branch.
